success.description: You and up to 1 other willing character per character rank vanish from your current location and appear in a new one, which may be anywhere in the world that is under the night sky. You appear near the spot you were aiming for, deviating no more than 5% of the total distance you have traveled.

chaosStar.description: You are way off-target. You vanish...but you reappear until the next night.

conservative.requirements: 10 power. You must have a clear view of the night sky to cast this spell. Special: If you have instruments for celestial observation and an accurate map marking the direction and distance to your destination, and you spend at least a half-hour using them, remove {Dc} from the dice pool. If your map is inaccurate, or you have no map, add {Dm} instead. This spell recharges at sunset.
conservative.name: Transposition

chaosStar.description: You are way off-target. You and all your passengers suffer 1 wound.
